- westd-16980, root@westd-16980

- 计算值: 23.5294%，Registry: 23.56%，delta=0.0306pp

- 导致 `docred_sample_stats` 中 `.lower()` 调用崩溃

   ```bash
   find /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie -name "*bootstrap*llama*" -newer /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/compute_bootstrap_ci.py
   ```

   - DocRED S1: outputs/llama_docred_full_s1.jsonl

   - SciERC: data/processed_data/test.json

   | Llama DocRED U | 5.98 | 55.65 |
   | Llama DocRED S1 | 6.27 | 55.01 |

   对每个对比(SciERC, DocRED)的 R-F1 和 E-F1：
   - Point estimate delta (pp)
   - 95% CI [lower, upper]
   - p-value
   - Registry alignment: computed value vs registry, delta, PASS/FAIL

   ```
   Llama SciERC R-F1: delta=-0.14pp, CI=[-0.XX, +0.XX], p=0.XXX
   ```
